Are you a driven logistics employee who likes to roll up their sleeves? At Fujipoly B.V. in Eindhoven, you ensure that goods are received smoothly, orders are picked correctly, and shipments are prepared for dispatch. You manage inventory and assist in production if necessary. Do you have logistics experience, speak English, and are physically strong? Apply now!

Manpower is looking for a Warehouse Operator for Fujipoly in Eindhoven.

As an operator, you ensure a smooth flow of goods within the warehouse. You receive goods, pick orders, and prepare shipments for dispatch. With your accuracy and dedication, you contribute to an efficient and organized logistics process.

    - Good command of the English language
    
- Experience in logistics

Do you want to be part of the coziest candy adventure in the Netherlands? Concorp in Waddinxveen has a great opportunity for you as a production employee! If you are a hardworking, motivated and passionate candy lover, then look no further, because we need you!

What are you going to do?

At this company, no day is the same. For example, one of your working days will look like this:

You come in and first grab a cup of coffee. The foreman distributes the production work and then everyone gets to work. Your tasks are diverse and varied. Sometimes you have to operate a machine, other times you stand at the assembly line and check the quality of products. Or you work in the warehouse: packing things and preparing them for shipment.

Together with your colleagues you make sure that all jobs are finished by the end of the day. Just make sure to clean up after and the job is done.

This job is a day shift and the working hours are from 07:00 to 15:00.

Waar ga je werken?

You will be working in the best candy factory in the Netherlands! Every day millions of candies race out of this factory. Well known candy brands such as Autodrop and Skittles are produced here.

It is a family business with now two factories in the Netherlands, including in Waddinxveen.

The company has an open and sincere corporate atmosphere. All employees feel connected and enjoy going to work together.

The company is easy to reach by car and by public transport. There is plenty of parking and it is within walking distance from the bus stop!

Wat vragen wij?

We are looking for someone who likes to roll up their sleeves and is not averse to working. And further:

- You are precise and can work well independently;
- It is important that you have at least basic knowledge of the Dutch and English language, both spoken and written;
- That you work neatly and ordered;
- That you can work well under high work pressure;
- Experience in production work is an advantage.

About the job

Are you precise, motivated, and do you enjoy working in a clean and well-organized environment? As a Cleanroom Operator, you will make sure that components are carefully cleaned, inspected, and packaged for customers in the high-tech industry.This is a varied position where accuracy, quality, and teamwork are key.

What will you do?

In this role, you will work in a cleanroom environment where precision and quality are essential. You will work with customers from the high-tech, medical, automotive, and aerospace industries — sectors where there is no room for error and where your work directly contributes to the final product.As a Cleanroom Operator, you will play an important role in cleaning, inspecting, and packaging components. You will work according to clear protocols and detailed work instructions.

Your responsibilities include:

- Cleaning components using modern machines or manually
- (Dis)assembling components based on technical drawings
- Performing detailed quality inspections, including inspections using UV lamps
Packaging components in the cleanroom to ensure they arrive at the customer in perfect condition

You will work in a modern, safe, and well-organized environment where teamwork and quality are highly valued.

What are we looking for?

- MBO-level education or equivalent working and thinking level
- Experience in a cleanroom or assembly environment is a plus, but not required — we are happy to train you
- Good command of English; Dutch is a plus
- You work accurately and independently and have a flexible attitude
- You are available to work in shifts: 06:00–15:00 and 15:00–00:00
- You don't meet all the requirements but think this position could be a good fit for you? We would still love to hear from you!

The Netherlands | Relocation to the Netherlands Are you an experienced Instrumentation or E&I Technician and interested in taking the next step in the Netherlands? We are looking for experienced E&I Technicians to join the maintenance team at the industrial site in the Netherlands. You will become part of an experienced team of around 18 E&I technicians, ranging from junior to senior level.
